learning.why: Teacher showed sphere as solid you can hold, like football vs flat circle. Child connected with laddoo example.

end.summary:
Matched everyday objects to cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere; this was shown with why/new-situation questions.
Recognised some 3D shapes in different positions and sizes; this was partly shown and needs more checking next time.
Practised naming all five 3D shapes; easy questions were right, but why/new-situation naming is still to check.
Used faces and features: square faces for a cube, rectangular faces for a cuboid, circular faces for a cylinder, and a point for a cone.
Asked for drawings when checking a cylinder in different positions.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching everyday objects with 3D shapes, and Ishita used features such as square faces, rectangular faces, circular faces and a point. They also practised recognising shapes when an object was turned; some answers were right, but this needs more checking next time. At home, show one object at a time from different angles and ask, “What shape is it, and which feature tells you?”
